subject: Job Application: Software Engineer Position
body: Dear Hiring Manager, I am writing to express my interest in the Software Engineer position at your company. I have a strong background in programming languages such as Java and Python, and experience working on large-scale projects. I believe my skills and enthusiasm for software development make me a great fit for this role. Please find my resume attached for your review. Thank you for considering my application. Sincerely, [Your Name]
